blurb: Stash 11.0.1 is the March 2020 release of Morgan Houppin's C UCI chess engine that introduces a transposition table and quiescence search over tactical moves. Built on magic bitboards, Zobrist hashing, iterative deepening PVS, hash-move and MVV-LVA ordering, and a tapered piece-square evaluation. Adapted to UCI over WASI on the poll helper.
fidelityNotes: Single-threaded plain wasm32-wasip1 build using the C poll helper; Hash capped for 32-bit memory.

features.label: Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit piece-type and color bitboards with legal move generation.

features.label: Magic Bitboards
features.implementation: 64-bit magic bitboards with precomputed sliding-piece lookup tables.

features.label: Iterative Deepening
features.implementation: Depth-by-depth root search tracking selective depth through quiescence.

features.label: PVS
features.implementation: Negamax principal variation search using zero-window probes and re-searches on fail-high.

features.label: Quiescence Search
features.implementation: Horizon search over unstable moves (captures, promotions, and evasions) with stand-pat cutoffs.

features.label: Hash Move Ordering
features.implementation: Prioritizes transposition-table best moves ahead of MVV-LVA captures and PSQT-scored quiets.

features.label: MVV-LVA
features.implementation: Orders captures and promotions by victim and attacker value.

features.label: Transposition Table
features.implementation: Zobrist-indexed hash table storing search bounds, depths, and best moves across iterations.

features.label: Tapered PSQT Eval
features.implementation: Incrementally maintained middlegame and endgame piece-square scores interpolated by remaining pieces.
